people.name: Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan
people.bio: Mr. V. Srinivasa Rangan is the Executive Director of the Bank and heads the Human Resources, Corporate Legal, Group Oversight & Secretarial, Investment Banking, Information Security Group, Ethics Function and Fraud & Vigilance functions of the Bank. Mr. Rangan was an Executive Director & Chief Financial Officer of HDFC Limited prior to its amalgamation with the Bank w.e.f. July 1, 2023. He holds a Bachelor’s degree in Commerce from University of Delhi and is an Associate of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
